          echo "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "MKL_DYNAMIC=FALSE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "OMP_DYNAMIC=FALSE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11.15"

      - name: Install immutable locked Python dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          python --version
          python -m pip --version

          python -m pip install \
            --require-hashes \
            -r requirements-lock.txt

          python - <<'PY'
          import numpy
          import scipy
          import pandas
          import statsmodels

          expected = {
              "numpy": "1.26.4",
              "scipy": "1.11.4",
              "pandas": "2.2.2",
              "statsmodels": "0.14.1",

          actual = {
              "numpy": numpy.__version__,
              "scipy": scipy.__version__,
              "pandas": pandas.__version__,
              "statsmodels": statsmodels.__version__,
          }

          for name, version in actual.items():
              print(f"{name}=={version}")

          for name, required in expected.items():
              if actual[name] != required:
                  raise SystemExit(
                      f"❌ {name} version mismatch: "
                      f"expected {required}, got {actual[name]}"
                  )

          print("✅ Immutable scientific environment verified.")
          PY

      - name: Verify confirmatory-readiness lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          python analysis/verify_confirmatory_readiness.py

      - name: Explicit epistemic status

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "Scientific claim status: UNDER INVESTIGATION"
          echo "Confirmatory promotion: BLOCKED"
          echo "Historical exploratory results: NON-CONFIRMATORY"
          echo "Future null protocol: MUST BE PROSPECTIVELY FROZEN"

      - name: Solar Periodicity Nuisance Audit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          python -m analysis.solar_periodicity_nuisance_audit

      - name: Verify Solar Periodicity Nuisance Audit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          python -m analysis.verify_solar_periodicity_nuisance_audit

concrete.feature:
cross_run_verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Recompute deterministic artifact
        run: npm run validate

      - name: Compute hash
        id: compute_hash
        run: |
          HASH=$(sha256sum core-scientific/publication-gate/report.json | awk '{print $1}')
          echo "current_hash=$HASH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo $HASH > current_hash.txt

      - name: Load historical hashes
        run: |
          mkdir -p .coherence-memory
          if [ ! -f .coherence-memory/history.log ]; then
            touch .coherence-memory/history.log
          fi

      - name: Compare with historical memory
        run: |
          CURRENT=${{ steps.compute_hash.outputs.current_hash }}
          echo "Current: $CURRENT"

          if grep -q "$CURRENT" .coherence-memory/history.log; then
            echo "Hash already observed in historical memory."
          else
            echo "New hash detected. Appending to memory."
            echo "$CURRENT" >> .coherence-memory/history.log
          fi

      - name: Commit memory if changed
        run: |
          git config user.name "coherence-bot"
          git config user.email "coherence@system.local"
          git add .coherence-memory/history.log
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Cross-run memory update"
          git push || echo "No changes to push"
